main_text.head: DIVINA PHILOSOPHIA, FVNCTIO DEORVM;
I.Fernel.in Medicin.praef.1. Aristot.10.Ethic.c.8. Eiusdem Ideæ Vniuersalis Propositio I.
main_text.p: Homo, cæterarum creaturarum omnium præstantissima nobilissimaque, cunctarum constitutus Princeps, imago & gloria Dei, propter quem etiam sua condidit Deus reliqua omnia: Diuinorū Caducorumq; simul est particeps, utriusq; societate gaudet, ANIMO videlicet & CORPORE constans. Gen.1. Psalm.8.1.Cor.11.7.2.physic.3.
Omnium maximè Animalium unus, ita nudus, egenus & inermis; tot ignorationis & vitiorum hostilibus expositus armis. Arist.4.de partib.an.10.Lactat.Firm.diuin.inst.1.2.c.9.

Insita tamen ei naturali sciendi appetitione, uberrimaq; perfectionis reliquæ adipiscendæ promptitudine & occasione fertur; quò possit recta ad illud tranquillitatis & beatitudinis quoq; suæ fastigium vel solus conscendere. 1.Metaph.1.1.Nicom.1. Vtriusq; verò assequendi methodus est uniuersa Philosophia.
ANIMO igitur perficiundo, PHILOSOPHIA præest: CORPORIS expoliendi curâ MEDICINA suscipit. Omnis disciplina & Ars perficere nititur id quod deest naturæ. 7. Polit.17.
Illi Ratio obstetricatur; huic Experientia: hanc Necessitas peperit; illam verò Admiratio. 1.Metaph.2.

page.notes: The title line "Eiusdem Ideæ Vniuersalis Propositio I." is set in a smaller type and is read as a sub-heading. The bare numerals II–V are the printed proposition numbers and are kept as paragraphs per the rules. Italic passages are marked as seen, though the exact extent of italics in the first paragraph is uncertain. The catchword "Cum" appears at the lower right, partly cut by the fold.
